# Data and descriptive Statistics

importamos la bd

```{r}
#install.packages("pder")
library(pder)
data("Mafia")
```

Limpiamos la bd

```{r}
# Cargar librerías
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Cargar shapefile de Italia
italy <- st_read("it_shp/it.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Tabla de equivalencias entre nombres del shapefile y del dataset Mafia
equivalencias <- data.frame(
  shp_name   = c("Turin", "Aoste", "Mantova", "Bozen", "Padova",
                 "Reggio Emilia", "Forlì-Cesena", "Massa-Carrara",
                 "Firenze", "Pesaro e Urbino", "Reggio Calabria",
                 "Siracusa", "Oristrano"),
  mafia_name = c("Torino", "Aosta", "Mantua", "Bolzano", "Padua",
                 "Reggio Nell'Emilia", "Forli' - Cesena", "Massa Carrara",
                 "Florence", "Pesaro E Urbino", "Reggio Di Calabria",
                 "Syracuse", "Oristano")
)

# Filtrar y renombrar provincias para que coincidan con Mafia
italy_clean <- italy |>
  left_join(equivalencias, by = c("name" = "shp_name")) |>
  mutate(province = ifelse(is.na(mafia_name), name, mafia_name)) |>
  filter(province %in% unique(Mafia$province))
plot(st_geometry(italy_clean))
```

Matriz de pesos

```{r}
{r}
library(spdep)
library(sf)

# Centroides y matriz W por knn=4
coords   <- st_centroid(italy_clean) |> st_coordinates()
italy_nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))
italy_W  <- nb2listw(italy_nb, style = "W")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Promediar variables por provincia (colapsar el panel)
mafia_avg <- Mafia |>
  group_by(province) |>
  summarise(
    y        = mean(y,        na.rm = TRUE),
    g        = mean(g,        na.rm = TRUE),
    mafiosi  = mean(mafiosi,  na.rm = TRUE),
    murder   = mean(murder,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Join con shapefile
italy_mafia <- italy_clean |>
  left_join(mafia_avg, by = "province")

# Función para no repetir código en cada mapa
mapa_italia <- function(variable, titulo, leyenda) {
  ggplot(italy_mafia) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = {{ variable }}), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = leyenda) +
    labs(title = titulo,
         caption = "Source: Mafia dataset (pder). Average 1986-1999.") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# Mapas individuales
mapa_y       <- mapa_italia(y,       "GDP per capita (y)",          "log GDP")
mapa_g       <- mapa_italia(g,       "Public Spending (g)",         "log Spending")
mapa_mafiosi <- mapa_italia(mafiosi, "Mafia Presence (mafiosi)",    "Rate")
mapa_murder  <- mapa_italia(murder,  "Murder Rate",                 "Rate")

# Ver los mapas
mapa_y
mapa_g
mapa_mafiosi
mapa_murder
```
